title: HQ Site Induction
description: A short walk-through of the HQ building: find key safety equipment, spot security and health & safety issues, and learn what to do when you leave.

objects.text:
Q3 ROADMAP
CONFIDENTIAL
— do not share —

steps.title: Welcome to HQ
steps.body: This is the reception on the ground floor. Drag (or move your phone) to look around. Pinch or scroll to zoom. Each step asks you to find something or answer a question.

steps.title: Find the first aid kit
steps.prompt: Look around reception and tap on the first aid kit.
steps.hint: First aid kits are wall-mounted and marked with a white cross on green. Try looking to your right, near the lifts.
steps.explain: The first aid kit is on the wall next to the lifts. Trained first aiders are listed on the notice board at reception — call reception on ext. 100 if someone needs help.

steps.title: Lanyard colours
steps.body:
You're now on the 10th floor. At HQ lanyard colours tell you who someone is:
• Blue — staff
• Green — contractor
• Red — visitor (must be escorted at all times)

steps.title: Spot the security risk
steps.prompt: Something on this floor isn't right from a security point of view. Find it and tap on it.
steps.hint: Check everyone's lanyard colour. Is anyone on their own who shouldn't be?
steps.explain: A visitor (red lanyard) is alone next to a confidential whiteboard and an unlocked computer.

steps.question: What's wrong in this scene?
options: A visitor with a red lanyard is on the floor without an escort
A colleague is working at their desk
The lift is stopped on the 10th floor
steps.explain: Red lanyards mean visitor. Visitors must be escorted by their host at all times — here they're alone beside confidential information.

steps.question: What should you do?
options: Nothing — they got past reception, so they must be allowed
Take a photo of them and post it in the team chat
Politely offer help, find their host or walk them back to reception, and report it to Security
Tell them to leave the building immediately
steps.explain: Be polite but don't ignore it. Offer to help, reunite them with their host or escort them to reception, and let Security (ext. 222) know so it can be followed up.

steps.title: Hazard hunt
steps.prompt: There are 3 health & safety hazards on this floor. Find and tap all of them.
steps.hint: Look behind you, and look down at the floor.
steps.explain: Blocked exits, trip hazards and unmarked spills are among the most common causes of office injuries.

steps.title: How to check
steps.prompt: Tap each marker to learn what to look for and how to check it. Open them all to continue.

hotspots.title: Fire exit
hotspots.body: Fire exits and the routes to them must be kept clear at all times.
checklist: Door is not obstructed on either side
Door opens freely and closes fully

hotspots.title: Fire extinguisher
hotspots.body: Know where your nearest extinguisher is and how to tell it's usable.
checklist: Safety pin and tamper seal intact
Pressure gauge needle in the green
Mounted, not used as a door stop

hotspots.title: Trailing cable
hotspots.body: Cables across walkways are a trip hazard.
checklist: Route cables along walls or under desks
Use a cable cover if a cable must cross a walkway
Report damaged cables — don't use them

hotspots.title: Spill
hotspots.body: Wet floors cause slips — clean up or cordon off straight away.
checklist: Put out a yellow wet-floor sign
Clean up if safe, or call Facilities (ext. 300)
Remove the sign once the floor is dry

steps.question: You're leaving the office for the day. What should you do before you leave the building?
options: Keep your badge on so security outside can see who you are
Hold the door open for the person behind you
Take your badge off and put it out of sight
Leave your badge on the reception desk
steps.explain: A visible badge outside tells strangers where you work and can be photographed and cloned. Take it off and put it away before you step outside. Visitors: drop your badge in the visitor badge box.

steps.title: You're done!
steps.body: Thanks for completing the HQ site induction. Your results are on the next screen.
